response.backstory: Evelyn Parker is a 79-year-old retired administrative assistant living on Social Security and a moderate pension in Maricopa County, Arizona. She feels well served by her current Medicare Advantage plan and established doctors, so she is reluctant to switch unless costs or coverage change substantially. As everyday tasks become a little more demanding, she is paying closer attention to preventive care, transportation support, and benefits that help her remain independent. She is willing to balance a manageable premium against richer coverage when it protects the relationships and care routines she values.
